label.explanation: msg-317067 at partition 8 offset 884736 contains bytes audit-consumer cannot parse. It is nacked and redelivered forever because no max-retries/DLQ is configured (lines 162, 163, 177, 178, 197, 198, 208, 209). That message blocks its partition, so lag grows (lines 185, 207, 214, 227, 248, 256, 268) and downstream work stalls (lines 206, 231, 249, 270). The consumer has capacity — it's stuck on one message. Dead-letter msg-317067 and add a retry limit. Red herrings: line 81 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits).
